Looking for a short-term stay for a male friend in San Francisco, preferably around Dogpatch, Potrero Hill, or Mission Bay.
 Dates: June 18 – July 8 (3–4 weeks)
Open to sublets, furnished rooms, shared apartments, or any leads in the area. Please DM me if you know of anything available. Thanks!

Looking for Housing/ Lease takeover in San Francisco (July Move-In)
Hi everyone! I’m looking for either:
• A studio or 1 bed / 1 bath apartment, or
• A room in a 2 bed / 2 bath shared apartment with a female roommate
starting in July. Ideally seeking a long-term lease, lease takeover, or renewal opportunity.
 Budget: Up to $3,000/month
A little about me:
• Working professional in tech
• Clean, quiet, and respectful
• Enjoy hiking, running, and exploring the city
• Looking for a comfortable place to call home in SF
Preferred neighborhoods:
 Marina
 Pacific Heights
 Embarcadero
 Nob Hill
 Russian Hill
 Mission Bay
 Mission Dolores / Mission District
 Potrero Hill
 Dogpatch
I’m also open to other neighborhoods if it’s a good fit.
If you have a place available or know someone looking for a roommate, please DM me. Thanks in advance! See less

Hey everyone! I'm a Stanford MBA student looking to sublet in SF from June 10 – August 16. Ideally a furnished studio or 1BR in Hayes Valley, Lower/Upper Pac Heights, the Castro, Mission, or SoMa/Mission Bay. Happy to provide references. If you or anyone you know has something available, please reach out! 
https://www.linkedin.com/in/malik-russell/

Hey everyone! I’m a medical student rotating with UCSF orthopedic surgery from June 26th-July 26th. Looking to sublease any available unit in Dogpatch / Potrero Hill / Mission Bay / Mission District ASAP.
Please DM me if you have anything available. Thanks!
